title: At 360 px the right panel no longer covers the composer when a page opens a tab on load; a ?tab= link still reveals it
steps: S1: As A (owner) open $O/<site>/ in a fresh 360x800 mobile context; wait for [data-composer-input="true"] plus 6 s. Read whether the frame carries [data-rightbar-collapsed], and document.elementFromPoint at the composer's centre.
S2: Same at 1440x900 in a fresh context.
S3: In a fresh 360x800 context open $O/new/?tab=tracy:my-sites and wait 12 s; read [data-rightbar-collapsed] and whether the My Sites tab text is on screen.
expect: S1: [data-rightbar-collapsed] present; the point lands inside the composer card (not in [data-rightbar-col]).
S2: [data-rightbar-collapsed] absent (the site preview is open beside the chat as before).
S3: [data-rightbar-collapsed] absent; the My Sites tab is visible.
evidence: ACC-30.C2a (tasks/evidence/site-changes-v2/dev-acceptance/ACC-30.C2a/composer-360.png): the Browser panel covered the whole 360 px frame; after the fix tasks/evidence/tracy-site-sweep/L3/K1/
fence: Fork ui-sidebar-right place(): on an autoFullscreen frame an open without transient user activation does not expand a collapsed column (OpenContentIntent.reveal=false); tracy-tab-link expands it for a ?tab= address

cmd: covering the conversation|any open on a wide frame|already expanded panel
